thread:
jamie: FYI noticed a weird spike in WS reconnects in eu-west1 at ~03:10 UTC, looks like duplicate billing on resume.
neha: any queries or screenshots?
jamie: console link attached: Streaming -> Route Diagnostics. route_bounce metric jumps around 03:12. sample trace id: trace-0a1b2c. Logs show a resume accepted on route alpha, then a proxy handoff, then resume accepted again on beta and billing incremented.
sam: that sequence sounds dangerous. i thought we made resume idempotent server-side.
lee: our sticky-lease TTL is 10s by default, and proxies can handoff before the resume handshake completes. if a new route doesn't recognize the lease it treats it as a new session.
neha: proposal: increase sticky TTL to 30s behind a canary flag, and emit route_before/route_after on resume telemetry so billing can dedupe.
jamie: console UX point: current metric `streams.reconnects` mixes fresh reconnects with resume events — support misinterpreted it as client flakiness. we should split metrics `streams.resume_events` and `streams.fresh_reconnects`. add tooltip: "resume = idempotent reconnect using resume_id".
sam: telemetry change: add a small field route_pair like `alpha->beta` and include trace_id in resume_event. keep payload minimal. 
lee: also add a billing-side dedupe: counterdedupe events with same resume_id within 60s unless new_session=true. low risk and can be gated.
neha: ops-bot: create canary flag `resume-sticky-ttl-30s` in eu-west1 at 5% traffic.
ops-bot: canary flag created and scheduled. owner: sam.
sam: i'll open a tiny PR for telemetry + billing dedupe + TTL flag. test plan: run resume-handoff replay in staging, assert single billing increment per resume_id.
jamie: please add a console annotation for the canary so alerts correlate.
neha: i'll update dashboard: split the reconnect metric rows and add a drilldown that shows resume id and route transitions.
lee: alert tuning: current alert fires on total reconnects > 200/min. with split, set fresh_reconnects > 50/min (notify oncall) and resume_events > 500/min (inform product). we can iterate after baseline.
sam: PR draft: https://git.redwood.ai/r/s/1234 (will post when ready).
jamie: also log a sampled client_resume_attempts field (1% sampling) so we can detect client-side replay storms without overload.
neha: agreed. we'll gate client resume meta behind sampling.
lee: timeline?
sam: PR today, staging tests tomorrow morning, canary starts in 2h, full rollout after 24h if stable.
jamie: support hold off external comms until root cause confirmed. thanks all.
ops-bot: alert created: fresh_reconnects_high -> notify #eng-oncall and #support.
